plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the permission for display purposes.

plainFields.name: permission_description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what this permission allows the administrator to do.

plainFields.name: is_granted
plainFields.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this permission is granted to the administrator grade.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission record was last modified.

models.name: discussion_board_system_settings
models.description:
System-wide configuration settings and feature flags managed by administrators for platform customization.

Provides centralized storage for all configurable system parameters including feature toggles, UI settings, performance configurations, and business rule constants. Each setting is stored as a key-value pair with appropriate data type specification and descriptive documentation.

Settings can be modified by authorized administrators through the administrative interface to customize platform behavior without code changes. Includes audit trail tracking to monitor configuration changes and maintain system integrity.

Examples of settings include: maximum file upload size, comment length limits, session timeout durations, email notification preferences, and feature availability toggles.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting, following dot-notation naming convention (e.g., system.email.notifications.enabled).

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Current value of the configuration setting stored as string representation of underlying data type.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Data type of the configuration value: boolean, string, integer, double, datetime, or json.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose and usage of this configuration setting.

plainFields.name: administrator_id
plainFields.description: ID of the administrator who last modified this setting for audit trail purposes. Follows {@link discussion_board_administrators.id} reference pattern.

plainFields.name: group
plainFields.description: Configuration group for organizational purposes (e.g., email, security, ui, features).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was first created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was last modified.

models.name: discussion_board_administrator_promotion_reviews
models.description:
Stores super administrator reviews of promotion requests including approval/rejection decisions and feedback.

This table tracks the review process where super administrators evaluate user requests to become administrators. Each review includes the decision (approved or rejected), detailed feedback explaining the rationale, and timestamps for audit trail purposes.

The review process is tied to promotion requests through the foreign key relationship, ensuring each review corresponds to a specific request. Super administrators who perform the reviews are recorded with their session context for accountability.

Reviews support the administrator promotion workflow by documenting approval decisions and providing constructive feedback for rejected requests to help users understand the criteria.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_administrator_promotion_request_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the promotion request being reviewed. {@link discussion_board_administrator_promotion_requests.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_super_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the super administrator who performed the review. {@link discussion_board_super_administrators.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_super_administrator_session_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the super administrator session during the review. {@link discussion_board_super_administrator_sessions.id}

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: Review decision indicating whether the promotion request was approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: feedback
plainFields.description: Detailed feedback provided by the super administrator explaining the decision rationale.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created and submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated for any modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for audit trail when reviews are removed.

models.name: discussion_board_administrator_grade_changes
models.description:
Audit log of all administrator grade change actions including promotions and demotions.

Tracks complete history of administrator grade modifications from regular administrator to super administrator and vice versa. Each record captures the administrator being modified, their previous grade, new grade, the reason for the change, and the super administrator responsible for the action.

Integrates with the administrator promotion request system to provide complete oversight of administrator hierarchy management. Supports audit compliance by maintaining immutable records of administrator grade modifications with full temporal tracking.

Includes soft deletion capability to maintain audit trails while supporting administrative cleanup operations where necessary.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator whose grade is being changed. {@link discussion_board_administrators.id}

foreignFields.name: responsible_super_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the super administrator who performed the grade change action. {@link discussion_board_administrators.id}

plainFields.name: previous_grade
plainFields.description: The administrator's grade before the change. Valid values: 'administrator', 'super_administrator'.

plainFields.name: new_grade
plainFields.description: The administrator's grade after the change. Valid values: 'administrator', 'super_administrator'.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Detailed reason for the grade change, typically citing performance, responsibilities takeover, or administrative requirements.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the grade change action. Valid values: 'pending', 'completed', 'cancelled'.

plainFields.name: effective_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the grade change becomes effective, allowing for future-dated promotions or immediate changes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the grade change record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the grade change record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the grade change record was soft deleted, maintaining audit trail integrity.

models.name: discussion_board_administrator_grade_permissions
models.description:
Associates specific permissions with administrator grades to enable role-based access control throughout the system.

This junction table implements many-to-many relationships between administrator grades (from administrator_hierarchies) and individual permissions (from administrator_permissions). Each record represents the assignment of a specific permission capability to a particular administrator grade level, allowing administrators to access only the functions appropriate for their grade. The system supports fine-grained access control by defining granular permissions that can be independently granted or withheld.

The table supports the permission matrix where regular administrators have different capabilities than super administrators, and additional grade levels can be easily accommodated in the future. As grade-permission mappings represent system configuration rather than user-facing content, this table uses a subsidiary stance managed through grade and permission entities.

foreignFields.name: administrator_grade_id
foreignFields.description: References the administrator grade being assigned permissions. {@link discussion_board_administrator_hierarchies.id}

foreignFields.name: administrator_permission_id
foreignFields.description: References the specific permission being granted to the grade. {@link discussion_board_administrator_permissions.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the grade-permission assignment was created, providing audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the grade-permission assignment was last modified, tracking configuration changes.

models.name: discussion_board_ban_records
models.description:
Stores all ban records with comprehensive details about user restrictions and administrative actions.

Captures the complete life-cycle of user bans including the banned user reference, banning administrator, detailed ban reason, duration specifications, and current status tracking. Supports active bans, expired bans, and manually revoked bans with full audit trail.

Each ban record links to the banned user through reference to the discussion_board_users table and the implementing administrator through discussion_board_administrators. Ban reasons comply with the minimum 10-character requirement for documentation clarity.

The table maintains temporal fields for creation, modification, and soft deletion, enabling comprehensive ban management and reporting capabilities for administrative oversight.

foreignFields.name: banned_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the banned user's record using {@link discussion_board_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: administrator_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the administrator who applied the ban using {@link discussion_board_administrators.id}.

plainFields.name: ban_reason
plainFields.description: Detailed reason for the ban implementation, providing clear documentation of the violation or cause. Minimum 10 characters required as per platform policy.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the ban: 'active' for currently enforced bans, 'expired' for time-based bans that completed, 'revoked' for manually cancelled bans.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban becomes active and takes effect on user access.

plainFields.name: effective_until
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban automatically expires. Null indicates indefinite ban duration requiring manual intervention.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban was manually revoked by an administrator before its scheduled expiration. Null indicates not revoked.

plainFields.name: revoke_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by administrator for manually revoking the ban before its scheduled expiration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban record was initially created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the ban record was last modified or updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of ban records, maintaining audit trail while removing from active operations.

models.name: discussion_board_ban_admin_actions
models.description:
Tracks administrative actions related to ban management for comprehensive audit trail and accountability.

Records every administrative action performed on ban records, including ban application, modification, extension, and removal operations. Each entry captures the specific administrator who performed the action, the timestamp of the operation, the type of action taken, and any additional context or notes related to the administrative decision.

Maintains referential integrity with both the ban records being acted upon and the administrators performing the actions. This audit trail supports accountability, compliance requirements, and administrative oversight by providing a complete historical record of all ban-related administrative activities.

The table supports moderation transparency and enables administrators to review the complete lifecycle of ban records, including who made specific decisions and when those actions occurred.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_ban_id
foreignFields.description: The ban record being acted upon. {@link discussion_board_bans.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_administrator_id
foreignFields.description: The administrator who performed this action. {@link discussion_board_administrators.id}

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed on the ban record. Valid values: 'application', 'modification', 'extension', 'removal'.

plainFields.name: action_context
plainFields.description: Additional context or notes about the administrative action, providing details about the decision or circumstances.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrative action was recorded.
